svg.title: Component diagram: the page of the workbench
svg.desc: The page has six components. The client of the hub connects to the workbench process through the link. The renderer reads the model from the client, finds the view in the table of views, and mounts it with props. The table collects the views and reads the sidecars. The views draw with the catalog.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
